output.reason: The company CBA sets payroll rules for permanent employees (karyawan tetap) that feed into PPh 21. These include the wage components and allowances, a THR of 120% of one month's wage, and an annual bonus. It also sets BPJS contribution rates. Employer-paid JKK 0.89%, JKM 0.30% and BPJS Kesehatan 4% are taxable benefits added to gross income. Employee-paid JHT 2% and JP 1% are deductible.
